name: HUSH: They can hear. (BETA)
desc:
The town has been taken over by monsters, you emerge from the sewers after hiding for so long. Seems like they hunt with sound. Sneak in, loot, and get out before they hear you.

Loot houses, shops, the hospital and the army camp. Hotwire cars, board up windows, there's exits and get inside before the doors shut. Get caught and you lose everything you carried. Sell your haul for guns, gear, gold guns and diamonds from the only shop left. Some people aren't as friendly.

CONTROLS
WASD move, Space jump, Shift run, C crouch (running: slide), Alt dive
E use, Tab backpack, M map, F flashlight, N night vision
1 2 3 weapons, Q holster, click fire, right click aim, R reload,  I inspect, V 1st person
Cars: F in/out, Shift drift, B belt, G wipers, H horn
Build, barricade, do whatever you must do to survive.

If your friends ask you what you're playing, tell them hushhhhhh (tell that to your friends)
